description: This file contains unit tests for the storage layer related to observability webhooks and dead letter queue management in a Go project. It tests CRUD operations, pagination, ordering, and error handling for webhook configurations and dead letter queue entries.

methods.name: setupObservabilityTestStorage
methods.description: Sets up a test storage instance for observability webhook tests, returning the storage object and context.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_SetAndGet
methods.description: Tests setting and retrieving the observability webhook configuration.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_Update
methods.description: Tests updating the webhook configuration and verifies timestamp updates.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_Delete
methods.description: Tests deletion of the webhook configuration.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_DeleteNonExistent
methods.description: Ensures deleting a non-existent webhook does not error.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_NilConfig
methods.description: Tests error when setting a nil configuration.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_EmptyURL
methods.description: Tests error when setting a configuration with an empty URL.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_NilSecret
methods.description: Tests setting a webhook config without a secret.

methods.name: TestObservabilityWebhook_EmptyHeaders
methods.description: Tests setting a webhook config with empty headers.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_AddAndGet
methods.description: Tests adding an event to the dead letter queue and retrieving it.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_Count
methods.description: Verifies the count of dead letter queue entries.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_Pagination
methods.description: Tests pagination over dead letter queue entries.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_DefaultPagination
methods.description: Tests default behavior for invalid pagination parameters.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_DeleteByIDs
methods.description: Tests deleting specific dead letter queue entries by IDs.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_DeleteEmpty
methods.description: Ensures deleting with empty or nil ID list does not error.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_DeleteNonExistent
methods.description: Ensures deleting non-existent IDs does not error.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_Clear
methods.description: Tests clearing all dead letter queue entries.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_ClearEmpty
methods.description: Ensures clearing an already empty queue does not error.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_NilEvent
methods.description: Tests error when adding a nil event to the queue.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_InvalidTimestamp
methods.description: Tests behavior with an event having an invalid timestamp.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_Ordering
methods.description: Verifies entries are ordered by creation time.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_LargePayload
methods.description: Tests handling of large payloads in events.

methods.name: TestDeadLetterQueue_MultipleEventTypes
methods.description: Verifies multiple event types are stored correctly.
